working_definition: Corazonin (Crz) neurons from the neuropeptide re-clustering; authors call the cluster corazonin neurons.

best_match.fbbt_definition: Corazonin neuron of the adult (Miyamoto and Amrein (2014) identify 2-4 Gr43a/Gr64a cells plus 4-6 other corazonin cells per hemisphere in the brain; McKim et al. (2024) find that only 3 non-Gr43a/Gr64a cells per brain hemisphere project via the nervus corporis cardiaci).

justification: Authors name corazonin neurons; FBbt adult corazonin neuron is the same type.
